FFmpeg 8.0.3 in this folder (ffmpeg, ffprobe) is splat's own static LGPL-2.1-or-later build,
redistributed as separate executables. It contains no GPL or nonfree components (no libx264/libx265).
Statically linked: zlib 1.3.2, FreeType 2.14.3, HarfBuzz 14.5.0, libopus 1.5.2, libvpx 1.15.2,
dav1d 1.5.4; the Khronos Vulkan headers 1.4.321.0 on Linux; the mingw-w64 runtime on Windows.
Licence texts: LICENSES/ and THIRD-PARTY.txt. Portions of this software are copyright © The FreeType
Project (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved.

Complete corresponding source, published with the binaries:
  https://github.com/voyager-so/vauss/releases/tag/ffmpeg-public-v3
  - every source tarball the binaries were built from (SHA-256 pinned), FFmpeg's signature and key;
  - the build kit (build.sh, sources.txt, per-target configure flags), also in the splat
    repository under dist/ffmpeg/;
  - each target's configure line, config.log and toolchain versions.

Rebuild: unpack the build kit, then ./build.sh TARGET OUT (see its README.md). SOURCE.txt beside
the binaries lists this target's components with their URLs and SHA-256s.
